title: P08 only + C02 + R08
description: This is the selected combined strategy. P08 supplies the expected stock-return vector by predicting the next monthly Barra factor coefficients and mapping them through current known exposures. R08 expanding variance supplies the modified allocation covariance, and C02 regular adds its historically selected diagonal stock-weight penalty. The original same-date covariance sets the penalty units and estimated 10% annual risk budget. This candidate was independently rebuilt from raw inputs and evaluated over 1990–2023. Its daily Barra penalty remains 0.0001, distinct from P08_R01.
